snippet.title: Roman Sands RE:Build | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
Arbitrary Metric and Serenity Forge have released a new trailer for Roman Sands RE:Build, confirming a September 16th release on PC for the apocalyptic hotel management game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231460/Roman_Sands_REBuild/

Secret Sauce Showcase Steam Event: http://obp.gg/secretsauce2026
